svg.title: ClearAI — 你的研究,长成一个本体
svg.desc: ClearAI lockup and title. Right: an abstract ontology — plain circles only — dark for concepts, light for value forms, emerald for the instance, which carries two conflicting assertions drawn in amber. Bottom: the seven stages of the epistemic loop.
